text:
Laura (Partnerships): Heads up — AWS marketplace needs final SOC2 artifacts + a pen-test confirmation from our SI partner before the listing goes live. timeline: vendor wants everything by EOD Friday.
Nick (Security): Copy. Which exact artifacts are they asking for?
Laura (Partnerships): They listed: SOC 2 Type II report (latest period), pen-test summary (redacted ok), vulnerability scan results, and an owners manifest for each artifact. Also an audit contact.
Olivia (Product): For SOC scope, confirm our Hosted API (r/o data plane) and Dedicated control plane are in scope. We should double-check subservice orgs.
Nick (Security): Right — must confirm how we map Dedicated vs Private for the marketplace listing. I'll verify scope with compliance.
Mike (Eng - Runtime): On the pen-test: SI sent a full report w/ IPs + stack traces. We should strip IPs and any customer data before sharing. I can scrub and produce a redacted PDF if legal ok.
Laura (Partnerships): Legal asked for an NDA between marketplace and SI if we're handing third-party reports. Jordan, can you create a presigned S3 folder for the upload? Need KMS-encrypted at rest.
Jordan (SRE): Yep. I'll provision s3://redwood-marketplace-artifacts/partners/si-vendor-2026-03 with SSE-KMS using key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/redwood-marketplace-key. Presigned PUTs valid 48h.
Jordan (SRE): Upload instructions I'll share:
```
# example for SI vendor
aws s3 cp pen-test-redacted.pdf s3://redwood-marketplace-artifacts/partners/si-vendor-2026-03/ --sse aws:kms --sse-kms-key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/redwood-marketplace-key
```
Nick (Security): Also require a manifest.csv with columns: filename, sha256, steward, redaction_level, original_report_date. We will verify checksums before handing to marketplace.
Laura (Partnerships): Marketplace wants the contact + timeframe. I'll provide marketplace@redwood.com as audit contact. Olivia — can you confirm product scope text for their form?
Olivia (Product): Drafting now. Will paste the scope snippet here in 30m.
Mike (Eng - Runtime): Quick Q: do we include our Dedicated GPU pool telemetry logs? They might want sample logs for patch history. Security — yay or nay?
Nick (Security): Only metadata + aggregated patch timeline. No raw logs or customer identifiers. We'll prepare an anonymized patch history CSV.
Laura (Partnerships): Great. Vendor action items: 1) Upload redacted pen-test + manifest 2) Send SOC2 Type II PDF (access-controlled) 3) Provide vulnerability scan summary. We then hand package to marketplace.
Marketplace Integration Bot: Reminder: marketplace listing requires evidence bundle file names to follow pattern RBW_<partner>_<artifact>_<YYYYMMDD>.zip otherwise their ingestion fails.
Laura (Partnerships): Thanks bot — we'll name them RBW_SIvendor_pentest_20260318.zip etc.
Jordan (SRE): I'm generating presigned URLs now. Will DM them to the SI vendor and drop the shortlinks here once done. :thumbsup:
Mike (Eng - Runtime): I'll do the redaction pass tonight and upload to the presigned URL once received.
Nick (Security): I'll review the manifest & redacted report tomorrow morning. If all good, legal will sign off and Laura can send to marketplace.
Laura (Partnerships): Plan sounds good. If we miss EOD Fri, marketplace might delay listing by two weeks. Everyone — please flag blockers asap. :pray:
